blocks.text: Bir nechta sifat: qaysi biri oldin?

Sifat otdan oldin keladi va o'zgarmaydi — bu qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 85-dars). Bu darsda savol boshqa: otdan oldin **ikki-uch sifat** kelsa, ular qaysi tartibda turadi? O'zbek tilida tartib erkin: «katta qizil uy» ham, «qizil katta uy» ham tabiiy eshitiladi. Inglizchada esa tartib ancha qat'iy: a **big red** house — to'g'ri, «a red big house» — g'alati. Ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar qoidani bilmaydi, lekin noto'g'ri tartibni darhol sezadi.

Sifatlar ikki guruhga bo'linadi. **Fikr sifatlari** — kimningdir bahosi: nice, lovely, beautiful, horrible, delicious, comfortable, strange, interesting. **Fakt sifatlari** — obyektiv belgi: new, old, big, round, red, Italian, wooden. Asosiy qoida: **fikr sifati fakt sifatidan oldin** keladi. a **lovely new** flat (lovely — mening fikrim, new — fakt), a **beautiful old** mosque, an **interesting young** writer.

items.text: We had dinner at a **nice quiet** restaurant by the river.
items.translation: Daryo bo'yidagi **yoqimli sokin** restoranda kechki ovqat qildik.
Samarqandda bir qancha **ajoyib qadimiy** binolar bor.

items.text: He's an **excellent young** surgeon from Bukhara.

blocks.text: Bir nechta fakt sifati kelsa, ular odatda quyidagi tartibda turadi. Har bir guruh bitta savolga javob beradi: qanday katta? qanchalik eski? qanday shaklda? qanday rangda? qayerdan? nimadan yasalgan? nima uchun? O'lcham va uzunlik (big, tall, long) shakl va kenglikdan (round, thin, narrow) oldin keladi: a **long narrow** street, a **tall thin** man.

blocks.text: Eslab qolish uchun inglizcha qisqartma: **OSASCOMP** — Opinion (fikr), Size (o'lcham), Age (yosh), Shape (shakl), Colour (rang), Origin (kelib chiqish), Material, Purpose (maqsad). Amalda otdan oldin **2–3 tadan ortiq** sifat kam ishlatiladi; ko'proq tafsilot bo'lsa, uni ergash gap yoki **with** bilan bering: a lovely old house **with** a red roof.

Otdan oldin sifatlar odatda **and** siz qo'yiladi: a **tall young** man («a tall and young man» emas). Istisno — **ranglar**: a **black and white** photo, a **blue, white and green** flag. Fe'ldan keyin (be, look, seem ...) esa sifatlar **and** bilan bog'lanadi: The room was **large and bright**. Uchtadan ko'p bo'lsa — vergul va oxirgisidan oldin and: The weather was **cold, wet and windy**. Qarama-qarshi belgilar **but** bilan: **cheap but comfortable**.

items.text: Her grandfather's old car was **red and cream**.
items.translation: Bobosining eski mashinasi **qizil va och sariq** rangda edi.

blocks.text: **be, look, feel, smell, taste, sound, seem** fe'llaridan keyin **sifat** keladi, ravish emas: You **look tired**. This soup **tastes delicious**. That **sounds interesting**. Bu fe'llar harakatni emas, egani **qanday ekanini** tasvirlaydi. Xuddi shunday holat o'zgarishini bildiruvchi **get, become, go, turn, stay, keep**: It's **getting dark**, The kids **went quiet**, **Keep calm**. Lekin fe'l harakatni bildirsa (qaramoq, tatib ko'rmoq), unga ravish kerak — sifat va ravish farqi haqida batafsil → 100-dars.

rows: He **tasted** the soup **carefully**. (ehtiyotlik bilan tatib ko'rdi)
The kids **went** to bed **quietly**. (jimgina yotishga ketishdi)

blocks.text: the first two days, the next few weeks

**first, next, last** son yoki **few** dan oldin keladi: the **first two** days (birinchi ikki kun), the **last three** years, the **next few** weeks. O'zbekchada tartib xuddi shunday — «dastlabki ikki kun», shuning uchun bu yerda faqat ehtiyot bo'lish kerak: «the two first days» — xato.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «a red big car» → a **big red** car; «an Italian old table» → an **old Italian** table; «a wooden beautiful box» → a **beautiful wooden** box; otdan oldin and: «a big and old house» → a **big old** house; «You look tiredly» → You look **tired**; «This cake tastes well» → tastes **good**; «the two first weeks» → the **first two** weeks.

sentences.text: We've just moved into a **lovely new** flat near the park.

sentences.text: Aziz is a **talented young** architect from Fergana.
sentences.translation: Aziz — farg'onalik **iqtidorli yosh** me'mor.

sentences.text: It was a **wonderful sunny** day, so we had lunch in the garden.
sentences.translation: **Ajoyib quyoshli** kun edi, shuning uchun bog'da tushlik qildik.

sentences.text: They live in a **strange round** house at the edge of the village.
sentences.translation: Ular qishloq chekkasidagi **g'alati dumaloq** uyda yashashadi.

sentences.text: Have you seen Kate's **gorgeous new** car? It must have cost a fortune.
sentences.translation: Keytning **ajoyib yangi** mashinasini ko'rdingmi? Juda qimmatga tushgan bo'lsa kerak.

examples.title: Size, age, shape and colour: **a big old** house
examples.description: Fakt sifatlari: o'lcham → yosh → shakl → rang. O'lcham va uzunlik (long, tall) shakl va kenglikdan (narrow, thin) oldin.

sentences.text: The old town is a maze of **long narrow** streets.
sentences.translation: Eski shahar — **uzun tor** ko'chalardan iborat labirint.

sentences.text: Bekzod drives a **small white** van for a delivery company.

sentences.text: In Canada we saw a **huge brown** bear right next to the road.

sentences.text: My son wants a **big new** phone with a better camera.

sentences.text: Our hotel was a **tall modern** building right next to the station.

examples.title: Origin and material: **an old Persian** carpet
examples.description: Kelib chiqish (Persian, Uzbek, German) va material (silver, cotton, leather) — otga eng yaqin turadi.

sentences.text: My aunt has a **beautiful old Persian** carpet in her living room.

sentences.text: Dilnoza bought a **lovely white cotton** shirt at the market.

sentences.text: These are **traditional Uzbek** dishes, all cooked by my mother.

examples.title: Purpose comes last: **running** shoes, a **sleeping** bag
examples.description: Maqsadni bildiruvchi so'z (ko'pincha ot yoki -ing) otga yopishib turadi — boshqa sifatlar undan oldin.

sentences.text: We bought a **big wooden dining** table for the new house.
sentences.translation: Yangi uy uchun **katta yog'och ovqat** stoli sotib oldik.

sentences.text: Oliver carries his laptop in an **old leather shoulder** bag.
sentences.translation: Oliver noutbukini **eski charm yelka** sumkasida olib yuradi.

sentences.text: Madina wore a **long red evening** dress to the wedding.
sentences.translation: Madina to'yga **uzun qizil kechki** ko'ylak kiydi.

sentences.text: Could you pass me that **little blue coffee** cup on the left?

examples.title: **and** with adjectives: **black and white**, **cold and wet**
examples.description: Otdan oldin and faqat ranglar orasida. Fe'ldan keyin sifatlar and (qarama-qarshi bo'lsa — but) bilan bog'lanadi.

sentences.text: The Uzbek flag is **blue, white and green**, with two thin red lines.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston bayrog'i **ko'k, oq va yashil** rangda, ikkita ingichka qizil chiziq bilan.

sentences.text: Our hotel room was **large and bright**, with a view of the sea.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadagi xonamiz **katta va yorug'** edi, derazadan dengiz ko'rinardi.

sentences.text: The weather in Manchester was **cold, wet and windy** all week.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda butun hafta havo **sovuq, nam va shamolli** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: My new phone is **cheap but reliable**, which is exactly what I need.

sentences.text: Jasur's grandfather was still **tall and strong** in his eighties.

sentences.text: She chose a **red and gold** scarf as a present for her sister.

sentences.text: At the wedding the food was **simple but delicious**.

examples.title: **look**, **feel**, **sound**, **taste** + adjective
examples.description: Holatni tasvirlovchi fe'llardan keyin sifat keladi: look tired, taste amazing, go quiet. Fe'l harakat bo'lsa — ravish.

sentences.text: You **look** really **tired** — did you work late again last night?
sentences.translation: Juda **charchagan ko'rinasan** — kecha yana kechgacha ishladingmi?

sentences.text: This plov **tastes amazing** — what's your secret?
sentences.translation: Bu palovning **ta'mi ajoyib** — siringiz nima?

sentences.text: Your plan **sounds good**, but how much will it cost?
sentences.translation: Rejangiz **yaxshiga o'xshaydi**, lekin qanchaga tushadi?

sentences.text: After a good night's sleep I **feel** much **better**.
sentences.translation: Yaxshilab uxlab olgach, o'zimni ancha **yaxshi his qilyapman**.

sentences.text: The roses in your garden **smell wonderful**.
sentences.translation: Bog'ingizdagi atirgullarning **hidi ajoyib**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **seemed nervous** before his first big presentation.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ilk katta taqdimotidan oldin **hayajonda ko'rinardi**.

sentences.text: When the teacher came in, the class suddenly **went quiet**.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi kirganda sinf birdan **jim bo'lib qoldi**.

sentences.text: It's **getting cold** — you'd better take a jacket.
sentences.translation: **Havo soviyapti** — kurtka olganing ma'qul.

sentences.text: Try to **stay calm** during the interview, even if the questions are hard.
sentences.translation: Savollar qiyin bo'lsa ham, suhbat paytida **xotirjam bo'lishga** harakat qiling.

sentences.text: Madina **looked** at the bill **angrily** and called the waiter.
sentences.translation: Madina hisobga **jahl bilan qaradi** va ofitsiantni chaqirdi.

examples.title: **the first two** days, **the next few** weeks
examples.description: first / next / last / past son yoki few dan oldin keladi: the first two, the last three, the next few.

sentences.text: The **first two** days of the course were the hardest.
sentences.translation: Kursning **dastlabki ikki** kuni eng qiyini bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I've been really busy for the **last three** weeks.
sentences.translation: **So'nggi uch** hafta davomida juda band bo'ldim.

sentences.text: Over the **next few** years, the city plans to build ten new schools.
sentences.translation: Kelgusi **bir necha** yil ichida shahar o'nta yangi maktab qurishni rejalashtirmoqda.

sentences.text: Jasur scored twice in the **first ten** minutes of the match.

sentences.text: Could you read the **last two** paragraphs again, please?

sentences.text: The **next three** months will be crucial for the company.

sentences.text: Most tourists spend only the **first couple of** days in Tashkent.

sentences.text: Emma has changed jobs three times in the **past five** years.

sentences.text: The **first few** weeks in a new country are always the most difficult.

sentences.text: I'll be away for the **next two** weekends, so let's meet in November.
